caveats.title: What the API says about these numbers

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.lede: Stored exposure runs, newest first. Every row is a claim that a named reef zone was reached, so nothing on this page has an offline fallback.
alerts.emptyBody: This is an answer, not a failure. An alert is written only when a stored exposure run reaches a named reef zone, and no stored run has reached one — so there is nothing to list. A zone that was not reached is a different statement from a zone that was reached with negligible effect.
alerts.tableCaption: Stored alerts by reef zone, with hazard band, exposure score, arrival window and source run
alerts.runLinkHint: Opens the stored exposure run this alert was written from, on the API.

events.title: Event catalogue
events.lede: Storms mined from the daily rainfall record, ranked on rank and maximum daily depth.
events.errorTitle: The event catalogue did not load
events.errorBody: GET /api/v1/events returned nothing. The API may not be running.
events.emptyBody: The API answered with no events at all. Nothing has been mined into the event table yet.
events.noMatchBody: The filter matches on event ID and label. Clear the box to see the whole catalogue.
events.filterFieldLabel: Filter by event ID or label
events.tableCaption: Mined storm events with start date, rank, maximum daily rainfall, wettest catchment and storm length
events.hidden: {{n}} further events match this filter and are not listed. Narrow the filter to reach them.
events.noLabelHint: Only events documented in the literature carry a label. The rest were mined, not named.
events.labelledHint: This storm is documented in the literature and carries a name; the rest were mined, not named.
events.replayLink: Open the replay for this event
events.rankingNote: Ranking uses rank and maximum daily depth. The catalogue's anomaly-ratio column is stale and is deliberately not shown here.
events.viewLabel: Choose a view of the event record

intensity.title: Rain intensity ranking
intensity.note: Storms ranked on rank and maximum daily depth — the canonical columns, never the stale anomaly ratio. Bar length is depth on one shared scale; “top N%” is where that depth sits in the wettest catchment's own 28-year daily record.
intensity.topPercentHint: This storm's daily depth is in the top N% of all days on record in its wettest catchment.
intensity.hidden: {{n}} further ranked events are not shown. The top of the ranking is here; open the catalogue for the full record.
intensity.empty: No ranked events to show yet.

calendar.title: Seasonal calendar
calendar.framingNote: Months coloured by rainfall intensity — the peak daily storm depth on record for each month, relative to the wettest month. This is a rainfall record, not a reef-exposure forecast: the sediment model is anchored to one October event, so this says nothing about coral impact by month.
calendar.worstLink: Open the replay for {{id}}, this month's heaviest storm
calendar.snapshotNote: Committed snapshot: the live endpoint was unreachable, so this reads the shipped export of the seasonal calendar.

reefZones.title: Reef zones
reefZones.lede: The eight named Jordanian zones, ranked by the exposure score of the latest stored run.
reefZones.loading: Loading reef zones and stored alerts…
reefZones.errorBody: GET /api/v1/reef-zones returned nothing. The API may not be running.
reefZones.tableCaption: Reef zones with current exposure, area, habitat, median depth, marine park overlap and sensitivity weight
reefZones.noRunHint: No stored exposure run mentions this zone. That is not the same as a run that found minimal exposure.
reefZones.placeholderWeight: Placeholder — an unreviewed 1.0, pending marine-scientist review.
reefZones.placeholderSummary: {{n}} of these zones carry an unreviewed placeholder sensitivity weight of 1.0. The habitat geometry is real Allen Coral Atlas data, but the weighting is not a scientific assessment — so this ranking reflects how much hazard reaches a zone, not how fragile the zone is.
reefZones.depthNote: Median depth is a bathymetric elevation: a negative value is below sea level.

reefZone.title: Reef zone
reefZone.errorTitle: The zone list did not load
reefZone.errorBody: There is no single-zone endpoint, so this page reads the zone list — and GET /api/v1/reef-zones returned nothing.
reefZone.notFoundBody: {{id}} is not one of the named Jordanian zones the API serves.

diveSites.label: Dive sites near this zone
diveSites.inlandBanner: These carry the "dive" tag in OpenStreetMap but sit tens of km inland — Wadi Rum desert attractions, not coastal dive sites. Their nearest-zone join is not a real safety association. Distances shown; full note on hover.
diveSites.errorTitle: The dive-site list did not load
diveSites.errorBody: GET /api/v1/dive-sites returned nothing. The API may not be running.
diveSites.emptyTitle: No dive sites map to this zone
diveSites.emptyBody: None of the 46 dive-site POIs have this zone as their nearest reef zone.

reefZone.weightsIntro: The two numbers below look alike and mean opposite things. The first is what the exposure engine multiplies by today. The second is a proposal derived from contributed photos, awaiting marine-scientist review, and is used nowhere.
reefZone.livePlaceholderNote: A team placeholder of 1.0, not a scientific assessment. Every exposure score for this zone is nonetheless multiplied by it.
reefZone.liveReviewedNote: Reviewed by a marine scientist. Every exposure score for this zone is multiplied by it.
reefZone.proposalNote: A proposal only. It has not been reviewed, it changes no exposure score, and it must not be quoted as this zone's sensitivity.

proposalStatusValue.INSUFFICIENT_PHOTOS: Too few photos to propose a value

reefZone.uploadLabel: Contribute a photo of this zone
reefZone.uploadHint: The image is classified on upload. Photos feed the proposal above; they never change the live weight.
reefZone.uploadFailedTitle: The upload did not go through
reefZone.uploadFailedBody: The photo endpoint returned nothing. Nothing was stored, so the photo can safely be sent again.
reefZone.heuristicWarning: This is a colour and texture heuristic, not a trained model. No classifier exists on disk, the rules were written by hand, and confidence is capped at 0.55 — so it cannot report high confidence even when it is right. It must not be presented as a neural network result.
reefZone.trainedBasis: Produced by a trained classifier. The model version above identifies the artefact that ran.
reefZone.photosUnavailable: The photo endpoint returned nothing, so neither the photo count nor the proposal can be shown.

replay.title: Event replay
replay.simulating: Running the particle simulation — each frame is rendered server-side and takes about {{seconds}} s…
replay.defaultedToAnchor: (no event given — showing the anchor event)
replay.noEventBody: No event ID was given and the committed event fixture could not be read, so there is no anchor event to fall back to.
replay.anchorFailedTitle: The anchor event did not simulate
replay.anchorFailedBody: The plume frame endpoint returned nothing for the anchor event. The API may not be running.
replay.onlyAnchorTitle: Replay is available for the anchor event only
replay.onlyAnchorBody: The particle engine needs a real flood arrival time, and only the anchor event has one recorded in the event-date register. For every other event the API answers 422 and refuses to guess a release time. Nothing is animated here on purpose: an empty animation would imply a plume shape that was never computed.
replay.basemapAbsent: not baked — frames render without it
replay.frameAlt: Modelled plume extent {{hours}} h after release, event {{event}}
replay.rendering: Rendering the next frame — about {{seconds}} s server-side…
replay.forcingTitle: What this animation does and does not show
replay.forcingBody: The engine is real; the forcing is not complete. On this build ocean currents fall back to a constant zero field and wind forcing is zero, so the cloud spreads by diffusion instead of drifting with a current. Timing and extent are meaningful, but a direction read off these frames is not.
replay.tableCaption: Modelled exposure per reef zone for this run
replay.noExposureRunBody: The exposure endpoint returned nothing for this event, so no zone-level result can be shown.
replay.noZoneReachedBody: The run completed and produced no zone results: the modelled plume reached no named zone within the horizon. This is reported as no exposure, not as zero-risk exposure — the caveats below carry the distances the engine measured.
